title: 2D platformer levels generated by AI in real-time
author: strawberry_yogurt

comments.author: strawberry_yogurt
comments.body:
Hey all, wanted to share a project I spent a few days on. I've been experimenting with applying AI generated art to games. In this project, I used a few models to generate fully playable levels of a simple 2D platformer. I'm curious if anyone else has experimented with anything like this - let me know what you think.

You can try it out as a web app here: https://laby.ai/ai-odyssey

comments.author: surpurdurd
comments.body: Absolutely fantastic. Can't wait to see this type of process applied to a lot of other aspects of games. Imagine "a level where progressing upwards is the primary goal, like ascending a tower" and the language adjusts the procedural generation to be more in line with the natural language command.
